title: Gusev Crater · Columbia Hills
subtitle: Spirit rover field site
summary: Spirit crossed the floor of Gusev Crater and climbed into the Columbia Hills. From Husband Hill, its panorama revealed layered terrain and the Inner Basin.
whyGo: Inspect bedrock and layered materials that reveal how the Columbia Hills formed and changed.
